# Somnostasis

> Autonomic biosignal intelligence and production MLOps platform for sleep stress prediction.
> Architected and developed by Krish Ujeniya (@krishujeniya).
> Developer Profile: https://github.com/krishujeniya
> Portfolio Showcase: https://krishujeniya.github.io/MostlyOutlier/
> Live Site: https://krishujeniya.github.io/somnostasis/
> Source Repository: https://github.com/krishujeniya/somnostasis

## Overview
Somnostasis processes continuous multimodal biosignals (PPG, EDA, ECG, respiration) during sleep phases to quantify autonomic stress response, deliver tree-SHAP clinical feature explanations, and monitor real-time sensor covariate drift.

## Author & Ecosystem
- Author: Krish Ujeniya (https://github.com/krishujeniya)
- Canonical Person Entity: https://krishujeniya.github.io/#krishujeniya
- Linked Projects: AGYOS, Hadron, WaferPulse, Curavex, Hajree, Scanlark, TraceMigo

## Key Architecture & Features
- Biosignal Feature Extraction: Time-domain HRV (RMSSD, pNN50), spectral power bands (VLF, LF, HF, LF/HF ratio), and non-linear Poincare geometry.
- Explainable ML: XGBoost ensemble with TreeSHAP calculating instant local attribution for each nocturnal stress peak.
- Drift & Telemetry: Population Stability Index (PSI) and Kolmogorov-Smirnov distribution checks alerting against wearable sensor degradation.
